# EXECUTION PLAN: COMI.CA

## Analysis & Decision Framework

### Thesis Reconciliation

**Bull Case Strengths:**
- NIM still expanding (no two consecutive flat quarters)
- EGX30 bullish trend provides tailwind
- COMI relative strength outperforming
- H1 2024 earnings catalyst imminent
- P/E 9.6x reasonable for 32.7% ROE
- Revenue +64.7% YoY, Net Income +83.9% YoY

**Bear Case Concerns:**
- 8.2x debt-to-equity leverage risk
- Negative 168bps earnings yield spread vs 27.25% risk-free rate
- No news flow/sentiment vacuum
- Technical indicators neutral with weak signals

**Resolution:** The bull case wins on stock-specific evidence. The bear thesis relies on generic macro risks already priced into 9.6x P/E. The "Lessons from Past Decisions" rule explicitly states to stay bullish while NIM is still expanding.

### Position Context
- Current: 8,159 shares at 73.34 EGP avg cost
- Market value: 630,364.34 EGP
- Unrealised P&L: +31,989.26 EGP (+5.3%)
- Max shares total (portfolio cap): 13,342 shares
- Room to add: 5,183 shares (13,342 - 8,159)

### Liquidity Assessment
- ADV-based max per day: 4,525,147 shares (not binding)
- Portfolio cap: 13,342 shares (binding constraint)
- Days to accumulate full position: ~1 day
- Normal liquidity - standard limits apply

| Parameter | Value | Rationale |

| Execution days | 2-3 | Split for price improvement |
| Portfolio allocation | ~100% | Full allocation to conviction call |

### Entry Logic

**Order Type:** Limit orders only (EGX constraint)

**Entry Zone:** EGP 72-76 (pullback range per thesis)

**Execution Schedule:**

| Tranche | Day | Time (EGT) | Shares | Limit Price | Order Type |

| 4 | Day 2 | 10:00-10:30 | 0 | 73.00 | Limit Day (if not filled) |
| 5 | Day 2 | 11:00-11:30 | 0 | 72.50 | Limit Day (if not filled) |

| Target | Price | % of Position | Cumulative Exit | Rationale |
|--------|-------|---------------|-----------------|-----------|
| TP1 | 85.00 | 33% | 33% | +13% gain, first resistance |

- **Type:** Limit order (no market stops allowed)
- **Note:** If price breaks below 65 with volume > 1.5x average, place limit sell at 65.00 for full position
- **Max loss:** ~12.5% from 74.50 avg entry

**Time Stop:**
- Review if H1 2024 earnings (expected Sep 2024) show NIM compression
- Exit 50% if NIM < 5% in H1 report
- Full exit if NIM < 4.5%

| Risk | Control | Action |
|------|---------|--------|
| Max loss per trade | 12.5% (EGP 9.50/share) | Mental stop at 65.00 |
| Daily execution limit | 5,183 shares/day | Below ADV constraint |
| Price limit risk (±10%) | If stock hits limit-up, cancel remaining orders | Wait for next session |
| Liquidity dry-up | If volume < 25% of ADV | Reduce tranche size by 50% |
| T+2 settlement | Cash unblocks Day 3 | Plan next tranche accordingly |
| Gap risk | Overnight news gap | Use limit orders only |

1. **Price breakdown:** Close below 65.00 EGP with volume > 1.5x average
2. **NIM contraction:** H1 2024 NIM < 5.0% (confirmed in earnings)
3. **NPL spike:** NPL ratio exceeds 5%
4. **CBE rate cut:** 200+ bps cut in single meeting
5. **EGP devaluation:** >30% in one move
6. **IMF suspension:** Program status changes from ACTIVE
7. **Technical breakdown:** Two consecutive limit-down days
8. **Negative disclosure:** Fraud, regulatory action, capital adequacy < 18%

### Monitoring Schedule

| Frequency | Action |
|-----------|--------|
| Daily | Check price vs entry zone (72-76) |
| Daily | Monitor volume vs 20-day average |
| Weekly | Review EGX30 trend and sector performance |
| Monthly | Check for earnings announcements |
| Post-earnings | Reassess NIM, NPL, CAR metrics |

---
